case_title: Ashok Kumar Mehra & Anr. v. The State of Punjab etc.
high_court_outcome: Convicted and sentenced to life imprisonment
neutral_facts: The accused, father and son, were prosecuted for the murder of a victim. The Sessions Judge acquitted both accused, but the High Court reversed this decision and convicted them, sentencing them to life imprisonment and a fine. The son, who was below 18 years of age at the time of the offence, raised the plea of juvenility for the first time in this appeal. The Court considered the son's date of birth and found that he was a juvenile at the time of the offence. The Court set aside the High Court's conviction of the son and acquitted him, noting that he had already served considerable jail time as an under-trial and convict.
